_comment: Single source of truth for down payment assistance program terms.
gen/compliance_check.py enforces this file. A post that names a program must
cite its official URL, must not repeat a known stale value, must date any
figure it states, and must not recommend a program whose
serviceAreaAvailable is false. Re-verify against officialUrl before writing,
and set verifiedOn when you do. Stale verification blocks publishing.

facts.assistanceMax: up to 4% of the loan amount
facts.forgivenessNote: Fully forgiven after 60 months. A sale or refinance inside the first 60 months requires the DPA second lien to be repaid.

Home in Five.administrator: Phoenix IDA and Maricopa County IDA

facts.assistanceMax: up to 7% of the loan amount
facts.assistanceBonus: an additional 1% for qualifying military, veterans, K-12 teachers and first responders

Arizona Is Home.unavailableReason: Not offered in Maricopa County, Pima County or Chino Valley. Every city we write for is in Maricopa County, so this program is not available to our readers. Do not recommend it.

facts.repaymentNote: Non-forgivable. The entire balance is due on sale or refinance.
facts.incomeLimit: at or below 100% of Area Median Income
facts.coverage: Apache, Cochise, Coconino, Gila, Graham, Greenlee, La Paz, Mohave, Navajo, Pinal, Santa Cruz, Yavapai and Yuma counties

Pathway to Purchase.verifiedAgainst: housing.az.gov program flier and homebuyer-assistance pages
Pathway to Purchase.unavailableReason: Limited to 17 named municipalities: Arizona City, Avondale, Buckeye, Casa Grande, Coolidge, Douglas, El Mirage, Fort Mohave, Goodyear, Huachuca City, Laveen, Maricopa, Red Rock, Sierra Vista, Snowflake, Tucson and Yuma. None of the cities we write for are on that list. Do not recommend it.
Pathway to Purchase.confidence: The eligible-city list and limits come from an Arizona Department of Housing flier that is not recently dated, and the program's current status is not confirmed. Confirm with ADOH before citing any figure.

facts.assistanceMax: up to 10% of purchase price, maximum $20,000
